release_use_policy: CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use with attribution. This provider-declared PCM training split is development-only Tier B sparse-domain training data. Its instruments are officially disjoint from NSynth validation and test, but it is not Tier A release evidence and must never count toward the disjoint release corpus.

sources.title: NSynth training split
sources.ground_truth_basis: Google documents 289,205 four-second musical-note examples distributed as 16-bit PCM WAV and states that training instruments do not overlap with validation or test.
sources.partition_basis: official training-split instrument ID; Google documents that train instruments do not overlap with validation or test
sources.limitations: The provider does not establish the pre-dataset encoding history of the commercial samples. Audio is monophonic 16 kHz single notes rather than complete recordings, so this is Tier B training data only.
